events.text: Deep in the forest, a black bear cub cries beside its mother, who will never get up again. Hunters' arrows are still in her side.

effects.log: It bites you twice on the way home and falls asleep in your arms. (A companion: it grows up.)
You walk away. The crying follows you a long way.

events.text: In a snowstorm, a grey wolf pup follows you for a whole day, keeping exactly ten paces behind.

effects.log: That night it sleeps against your back. In the morning it is eleven paces closer. (A companion.)
It goes. You look back more often than you would like to admit.

events.text: A black stallion runs with the wild herds on the northern steppe. Herders say no one has ever sat on its back for more than a breath.

ok.log: Three days, a broken rib, and then it stops fighting and lets you ride. The herders cannot believe it. (A Thousand-Li Horse: journeys free, faster escapes.)

fail.log: It throws you into the grass, again and again. On the third day it simply gallops away, and you are almost glad.

choices.text: Watch it run and let it be

events.text: A herder offers you a black colt of the old Thousand-Li line, too wild for him to keep, for a fair price.

effects.log: It takes a month before it lets you near without biting. Then it is yours for life. (A Thousand-Li Horse.)
The herder shrugs and rides away on it, very slowly.

events.text: A white crane with a broken wing stands in the marsh, too proud to fly away and too hurt to try.

choices.text: Splint the wing and nurse it

effects.log: It takes a season. When it can fly again, it doesn't. (A white crane: energy grows with your bond.)
The next morning the fish are gone, and so is the crane.

events.text: {pet_name} is no longer small. One morning you realise the cub you carried home now carries you.

effects.log: You lose, laughing, flat on your back. The neighbours bring their children to watch.
Two weeks of wandering. {pet_name} hunts, you think. You both come back stronger.

events.text: Bandits ambush you in a ravine at dusk. Before you can turn, {pet_name} is already between you and the knives.

ok.log: The bandits break and scatter, screaming about demons. {pet_name} is smug for a week.

fail.log: You both get hurt, but you both walk out. You tend {pet_name}'s wounds before your own.

events.text: A rich merchant's son brags that his horse is the fastest in the province, and bets nothing but pride on a race.

ok.log: {pet_name} wins by ten lengths and looks back as if to ask what took the other horse so long.

fail.log: {pet_name} stops halfway to eat a very interesting flower. You lose with great dignity.

effects.log: The merchant's son tells everyone you were afraid. {pet_name} glares at him.

events.text: {pet_name} is old now, grey at the muzzle, and sleeps in the sun most of the day.

effects.log: You talk about old journeys. {pet_name} thumps the ground, remembering too.
One last tour of every place you went together.
